name: Gellénháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gellénháza (a green and red shield with two black horses and a sabre, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name GELLÉNHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gellénháza arms with helm, crest and mantling
